about.title: Our Story
about.paragraph1: Alièfè was born from a passion for Ivorian gastronomy and the art of sharing food. Based in Casablanca, our mission is to introduce the authentic flavors of Côte d'Ivoire through dishes prepared with care, fresh produce and traditional know-how.
about.paragraph2: Every event — wedding, birthday or seminar — becomes a warm, unforgettable moment, where your guests travel to the heart of Ivorian flavors, as if they were back home.
about.missionText: Offering an authentic, elegant culinary experience.
about.visionText: Becoming the reference for upscale Ivorian catering in Morocco.
